svg.title: D L Narayana — data systems, full-stack products, applied AI
svg.desc: Engineering-drawing style profile sheet. Left: the name D L Narayana, the line 'Data systems, full-stack products, applied AI', the tagline 'Data in motion. Products on top. AI with a human in the loop.' and a feature control frame reading 'position: inspectable, datums A B C'. Right: an exploded isometric assembly of three plates - A data systems with bronze, silver and gold storage cylinders, B products with interface panels, C applied AI with an agent graph - and an inspection probe labelled D assurance touching the top plate.
